title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Industry \& Sector:** 
 Operating in the residential and commercial real estate sector in India, this role supports property sales, channel partnerships, and customer advisory services across primary and secondary markets. The team focuses on end\-to\-end client acquisition, site coordination, and deal closure for property portfolios spanning apartments, plotted developments, and commercial space.
   

  

**Primary Job Title:** 
 Real Estate Business Development Executive
   

  

* 🔹 Key Responsibilities:
+ Identify and generate new business opportunities in the real estate market.
+ Build and maintain strong client relationships to drive revenue growth.
+ Conduct market research to understand customer needs and competitor activity.
+ Promote real estate projects through calls, meetings, and site visits.
+ Achieve monthly and quarterly sales/business development targets.
+ Follow up with leads generated through marketing and convert them into clients.
+ Coordinate with the sales team for closures and ongoing client support.
+ Participate in promotional activities, exhibitions, and events for lead generation.


**🔹 Skills \& Requirements**
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Confident personality with a go\-getter attitude.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet targets.
* Basic understanding of the real estate industry (training will be provided for freshers).
* Good presentation and client handling skills.
* Own vehicle preferred (site visit requirement).


**🔹 Perks \& Benefits**
* Attractive incentives \& performance bonuses.
* Career growth opportunities in a fast\-growing real estate organization.
* Training \& mentorship from industry experts.


 Skills: salesforce,sales,business development,real estate,negotiation

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Business Development Executive role based in Sadar. The role involves identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, generating qualified leads, and building a strong pipeline of prospects. The Business Development Executive will conduct market research, engage with potential clients, present solutions, and support the negotiation and closing of deals. Responsibilities include managing key accounts, maintaining long\-term customer relationships, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth delivery and customer satisfaction. The position also requires preparing sales reports, tracking performance against targets, and contributing to business growth strategies.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess skills in New Business Development and Lead Generation.
* Candidates should possess skills in Business and Account Management.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills.
* Experience in B2B sales, industrial or security automation products is beneficial.
* Ability to work on\-site in Sadar, travel for client meetings, and meet sales targets.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Proficiency with CRM tools, MS Office, and basic data analysis is an advantage.

title: Sales And Demo Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Graphonix Infotech Pvt Ltd is a leading advertising and design company in India, headquartered in Meerut, with a strong presence across the National Capital Region. Founded in 2000, the company has grown rapidly and is recognized for high\-quality, award\-winning work acknowledged by organizations such as FESPA and ET Now. Graphonix operates as an integrated marketing and advertising agency, delivering innovative designs and digital solutions for clients seeking creativity and impactful branding. Each project is approached with tailored research and strategy, rejecting a “one size fits all” mindset. The company blends aesthetics with technology to create interactive media and business\-focused results.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales and Demo Executive role based in Meerut. The Sales and Demo Executive will be responsible for presenting and demonstrating Graphonix’s advertising, design, and digital solutions to prospective and existing clients, clearly communicating value, features, and benefits. The role includes identifying new business opportunities, generating and qualifying leads, and following up on inquiries through calls, emails, in\-person meetings, and events. The individual will support the entire sales cycle: preparing proposals and presentations, coordinating with design and technical teams, and ensuring smooth handover of confirmed projects. Day\-to\-day tasks also involve maintaining accurate records in CRM or tracking tools, collecting client feedback, monitoring market trends and competitors, and contributing to sales targets and revenue growth.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong sales skills, including lead generation, prospecting, negotiation, and closing, with a target\-driven mindset.
* Excellent presentation and demonstration abilities, with confidence in explaining creative and digital services to diverse stakeholders.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills in English and local languages, with professional client\-facing etiquette.
* Basic understanding of advertising, branding, and digital marketing concepts, with the ability to translate client needs into clear briefs.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills, including maintaining records, planning meetings, and managing multiple opportunities.
* Ability to collaborate with creative, design, and technical teams to prepare proposals, demos, and customized solutions.
* Comfort with using office productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, email, CRM or lead\-tracking software).
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in sales, business development, or client servicing (experience in advertising, design, or digital agencies is an advantage).
* Self\-motivated, eager to learn, and open to field visits, client meetings, and occasional extended hours to meet deadlines or targets.
